name: Deadman's Hand's Freeze roots the struck creature, not the wearer (#9606)
contract: Deadman's Hand (34227/1584227/1684227) equips spell 27867 Freeze, a SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL passive (ProcFlags all TAKEN_*, ProcChance 5) that casts 27868 on being struck. #9606 reports the root landing on the wearer instead of the attacker. Spell.dbc's own EffectImplicitTargetA[0] for the triggered spell 27868 is TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY (6), the explicit-unit-target kind: AuraEffect::HandleProcTriggerSpellAuraProc resolves triggerTarget to the attacker (eventInfo.GetActor()) for a taken-hit proc and calls triggerCaster->CastSpell(triggerTarget, ...), so Spell::SelectImplicitTargets should bind the root to that explicit target. This proves the live target resolution directly: casting 27868 with an explicit enemy target must root that target, not the caster.

steps.label: Learn the proc's root payload for a direct, deterministic target check
Cast Freeze's trigger spell at the dummy, as the proc's internal CastSpell(triggerTarget=attacker, ...) would
DISCRIMINATING: the struck creature carries the root, not the wearer
CONTROL: the wearer is not rooted by its own proc
